title: Admission mode
subtitle: How people enter the reserved modules of Guide Négo. The change takes effect at the next attempt, with no deployment.

forbidden.scope: Administer Guide Négo, across the whole platform
forbidden.description: The admission mode is reserved for platform-wide administrators. An account scoped to a single event has no access to it.

code.label: Code only
code.description: A valid code opens the modules right away. Nobody has anything to decide.

approval.label: Approval only
approval.description: The app no longer asks for a code: everyone files a request, and you decide.

code_and_approval.label: Code and approval
code_and_approval.description: The code is asked for, but it does not open: it opens a request carrying it, and you decide knowing who holds the code.

effects.title: What the person will see
effects.offersCode: The code field is offered to them.
effects.noCode: The code field disappears from their journey.
effects.codeOpens: A valid code opens the modules immediately.
effects.needsApproval: They wait for your answer, which reaches them by email.
